diagnostics.message: The aws_eks_cluster.this must wait for aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.cluster_encryption so the cluster role has the encryption permissions before EKS creates the encrypted cluster. The attachment exists only when the encryption policy is enabled; add ordering for that case.
The aws_eks_node_group.this should wait for aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.additional; the node group may otherwise launch nodes before custom policies required by those nodes are attached.
aws_eks_cluster.this should wait for aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.additional so any configured additional cluster-role permissions are attached before EKS creates the cluster.
